style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright daylight
subject: ONE herring in a seller apron, silver blue, big round eye, fins as hands
second_characters: ONE crab buyer fighting him for the roe every beat, claw huge at the lens; ONE shrimp crossing the lens

props.big: ONE open glass jar packed with orange roe, carried in his fins
props.small: ONE tiny glass jar, exactly three roe beads in it, ONE price card already flat on its side from the start, 1499 in four figures of one height

environment: a stall in a wall of kelp and crates filling the frame top and bottom, shoals and scales blowing through
lighting: bright white daylight in clear turquoise water, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hero fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his head never under a quarter of it, always within a fin of the lens. The camera never stops: it orbits him on a hard arc, a new shot size every beat, medium to close, crates and kelp sweeping the full frame width behind him. He carries what he holds and throws his whole body the full frame width. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, never repeated, last word праздникам done by 7.35, then glass carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: in-FLYA-tsi-ya, FI-cha, pri-spo-SO-bi-lis, zu-BOK, od-NOY, PRAZD-ni-kam

whips the jar up over the lens, beads blazing across it; the crab drags a crate through the frame
drives his mouth at the lens through flying lids; the crab snaps its claw across the glass
